metrics.method: Full history 2025-09-14 to 2026-09-23 (1,547 exported lines, roughly 300 of which are wordless voice notes from the onboarding script recording). 'Questions' is a best-effort count of client messages containing an explicit question or request requiring an ALTR answer. 'Unanswered over 24h' counts distinct asks left without a substantive reply for a day or more, including the five 'how do I increase my earnings' asks, the Orlando/Adelaide videographer, proof of posting on the management-run IG pages, the alexpaige.vip link image, the payment-received confirmations of May 2026, the surgery disclosures and the resignation. max_team_silence_days is the longest run with zero ALTR outbound (2026-08-01 to 2026-08-10); the post-resignation gap was 4 days. 'Promises' counts explicit forward commitments in ALTR messages with a verifiable outcome in the chat.
